how: Theorem A's third part. The algebra is argued by the seat and is standard (the half-turn fixes the base line and negates the fibre). Its count, one base-reversing isometry that negates the mark and not two, was conceded by agy-exp (harvest row 1719); the symmetry group of b++LLLLLLRLR has order 4 on main (SnapPy). The manifold facts it rests on are from earlier work (B1887) and are not rerun here
